mapper.select: SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bankAccountId, ID AS id, BANK_NAME AS bankName, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE ID = #{ownerId} ORDER BY BANK_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT_ID

SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bankAccountId, ID AS id, BANK_NAME AS bankName, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANK_ACCOUNT (BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, ID, BANK_NAME, BALANCE, ACCOUNT_TYPE) VALUES (#{bankAccountId}, #{id}, #{bankName}, #{balance}, #{accountType})
mapper.select: SELECT H.HISTORY_ID AS historyId, H.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bankAccountId, H.TX_TYPE AS txType, H.AMOUNT AS amount, H.COUNTERPARTY_ACCOUNT_ID AS counterpartyAccountId, H.BALANCE_AFTER AS balanceAfter, H.TX_MEMO AS txMemo, H.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ACCOUNT_HISTORY H JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT B ON B.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = H.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE H.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND B.ID = #{ownerId} ORDER BY H.CREATED_AT DESC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE BANK_ACCOUNT SET BALANCE = BALANCE - #{amount} WHERE BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND ID = #{ownerId} AND BALANCE >= #{amount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_HISTORY (BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, TX_TYPE, AMOUNT, COUNTERPARTY_ACCOUNT_ID, BALANCE_AFTER, TX_MEMO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{bankAccountId}, #{txType}, #{amount}, #{counterpartyAccountId}, #{balanceAfter}, #{txMemo}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
